How do you know if your AI cache is actually working—or just quietly serving wrong answers❓When you introduce semantic caching to handle natural language variations, tuning your distance threshold is a tightrope walk. Set it too loose, and your agents start hallucinating false positives. Set it too strict, and your cache hit rate drops to zero.In the final installment of our series on Semantic Caching for AI Agents, we cover:The essential observability metrics you need (Hit Rate, Precision, Recall, and LLM-as-a-judge validation).How to orchestrate an AI agent using LangGraph to decompose complex queries and check the cache dynamically.Tying it all together into an end-to-end production architecture.👇 Read the final part of the series here: https://lnkd.in/euyuNU9yPart 1: https://lnkd.in/e-fJ7GXiPart 2: https://lnkd.in/erGaGnNp#ArtificialIntelligence #MachineLearning #LLM #SoftwareArchitecture #RAG #AIAgents #LangGraph #Observability
